scripts.build: npm run build -w @wingman/core && npm run build -w @wingman/cli && npm run build -w @wingman/server
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @wingman/core && concurrently -k -n core,server "npm run dev -w @wingman/core" "npm run dev -w @wingman/server"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @wingman/core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:postgres: npm run build -w @wingman/core && npm run test:postgres -w @wingman/server
